intro: Clock questions are about the angle between the hands, the time seen in a mirror, when the hands meet, and clocks that run fast or slow.

tips.title: How fast the hands move
tips.body: The minute hand moves 6° a minute (360° an hour). The hour hand moves 30° an hour, which is ½° a minute.

tips.title: The angle between the hands
tips.body: Hour hand = 30 × hours + ½ × minutes; minute hand = 6 × minutes. Subtract. If the answer is over 180°, the smaller angle is 360° minus it.

tips.title: Reflex angle
tips.body: The reflex angle is the bigger way round: 360° minus the smaller angle. At 7:28 the hands are 56° apart, so the reflex angle is 304°.

tips.title: Mirror times
tips.body: A clock and its mirror image always add up to 12:00. Take the mirror time away from 11:60: a mirror 4:45 is really 7:15.

tips.title: When the hands meet
tips.body: The minute hand gains 5½ minute spaces a minute on the hour hand. Between h and h + 1 o'clock they meet 60h/11 minutes after h: at 6:32 8/11, for example.

tips.title: Fast and slow clocks
tips.body: A clock that gains g minutes a day gains g ÷ 24 minutes each hour. Multiply by the hours that have passed.
